card.title: HTTP Interceptor for Tokens and Retries

a1.cap: Every API call needs Authorization: Bearer <token>. Write a functional HTTP interceptor that adds the header to requests for /api, retries GET requests twice on network or 503 errors with a short delay, and register it.

lines: Every API call needs Authorization: Bearer <token>. Write a functional HTTP interceptor that adds the header to requests for /api, retries GET requests twice on network or 503 errors with a short delay, and register it.

a1.cap: Interceptors sit between your code and the network. Since requests are immutable, clone the request with the extra header. RxJS retry with a delay function re-subscribes on failure; limit it to safe, idempotent GET requests and to errors that are worth retrying.
A functional interceptor receives the request and a next handler.
Requests are immutable, so clone with the Authorization header added, only for our own /api URLs.
retry re-sends the request when it fails.
Only GET requests are retried, because repeating a POST could create duplicates.
Network errors (status 0) and 503s wait a little longer each attempt; other errors fail immediately.
Register the interceptor when providing HttpClient.
